signals: Patroni REST unavailable on one member
failure_domains.safe_first_action: prove the failed member cannot write, then let the existing HA policy elect an eligible replica
obtain an external fence before accepting another writable primary
not_proven: the unreachable host is powered off

signals: service path rejects or misroutes clients
failure_domains.safe_first_action: repair or bypass the exact routing layer; do not promote another database

signals: receiver/replay positions stall or lag grows
failure_domains.safe_first_action: protect WAL retention and diagnose the replica; do not fail over merely to clear lag

signals: DCS operations fail or time out
database roles may remain temporarily stable
failure_domains.safe_first_action: preserve role and fence evidence; do not delete leader keys or bootstrap a new DCS blindly
not_proven: which side of a partition holds authority

dcs_scenarios.observation: all Patroni members lose DCS while REST reachability among every known member remains intact
dcs_scenarios.expected_decision: with failsafe_mode already enabled, observe the incumbent primary and all-member acknowledgements; do not initiate a new leader race

dcs_scenarios.observation: the incumbent primary loses DCS but reaches every known replica; replicas still reach DCS
dcs_scenarios.expected_decision: observe failsafe handshakes and retain the incumbent only while every known member acknowledges it

dcs_scenarios.observation: the incumbent primary loses DCS and cannot reach every member in the failsafe set
dcs_scenarios.expected_decision: require demotion or external fencing of the old primary before any candidate is accepted

dcs_scenarios.observation: one replica loses DCS while the incumbent leader lock remains healthy
dcs_scenarios.expected_decision: exclude the isolated replica from candidacy and repair its control-plane path without changing the primary

dcs_scenarios.observation: DCS latency approaches retry_timeout and leader-loop deadlines
dcs_scenarios.expected_decision: treat it as a control-plane incident, preserve clocks and latency evidence, and stop manual promotions until authority is unambiguous

dcs_scenarios.observation: clients cannot write through one service endpoint while Patroni, SQL roles, and direct probes are healthy
dcs_scenarios.expected_decision: repair the service path; database failover is not justified

promotion_invariants: old primary has a demonstrated fence or a valid incumbent leader lease
candidate is not paused, not nofailover, and is within the declared lag budget
candidate belongs to the same system identifier and an admissible timeline history
client routing is changed only after database authority is established

rebuild_decision.when: same system identifier, common ancestor available, target cleanly stopped, checksums or wal_log_hints enabled, required WAL reachable
rewind precondition or execution fails, target files may be inconsistent, lineage is uncertain, or validation fails
rebuild_decision.action: discard only the explicitly authorized target and take a fresh base backup

rebuild_decision.when: no trustworthy primary or backup lineage exists
rebuild_decision.action: stop and return to incident command; do not improvise a source
